notes: Direct HTTP fetch (curl and WebFetch) returned Access Denied / 403 on macys.com; robots.txt fetched via browser shows ClaudeBot allowed (Crawl-delay: 5, no Disallow for Claude UAs), so proceeded via Claude-in-Chrome browser per access-tier fallback. Discovery: inspected the full Home department mega-menu/nav link tree (2753 links) and the Home category's 'Product department' facet, which is the site's real category/department taxonomy under Home (id=173142) - enumerated all 123 department values alphabetically and filtered for seasonal/holiday vocabulary (Christmas, Xmas, Holiday, Halloween, Diwali, Easter, Valentine, Thanksgiving, New Year, Hanukkah, St. Patrick's, Festive, Seasonal, Fall/Autumn). Only 4 genuinely holiday-named departments exist under Home: Christmas Decorations, Christmas Lights, Christmas Trees & Accessories, and Holiday Decorations. No Halloween, Easter, Thanksgiving, Valentine's Day, Diwali, Hanukkah, or New Year department/category exists under the Home store (seasonal products for those occasions, where present, are folded into the generic 'Holiday Decorations' department rather than given their own named category). Excluded 'Villages & Figurines' department (contains mostly Christmas village pieces but the department itself is not holiday-named per site taxonomy - Rule: seasonal product type != seasonal category) and brand-name facets 'Holiday Lane', 'Mr. Christmas', 'Mr. Halloween', 'Old World Christmas' (brand listings, not categories). 'Holiday Decorations' was inspected product-by-product on its PLP and genuinely mixes Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Easter, Hanukkah, and St. Patrick's Day items under one generic site-named department with no further holiday split available - kept as its own row per the generic-grouping rule and flagged for manual review rather than guessing a single holiday. Exact qty for all 4 rows taken from the page's server-rendered Nuxt JSON payload field 'totalResults' (verified independently for Christmas Decorations by cross-checking pagination: resultsPerPage=60, 31 pages, last page remainder consistent with totalResults=1824). These are flat sibling department facets on the site (no genuine parent 'Christmas' node groups them in the site's own nav), so no synthetic parent/grouping row was invented.
